verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could receive from Mastra. mastra-docs-19 describes ingesting inbound webhook events into agent threads, and MCP events (mastra-docs-7/8) are an MCP pub/sub mechanism rather than webhooks. Both are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
